proof_summary: Assuming the first claimed identity, the shifted values \(u_k=a_{3773+k}+1\) obey the Fibonacci recurrence; a modular Fibonacci computation modulo \(p=195318521017\) at \(k=249580073233\) gives \(u_k=u_{k+1}=1\), so \(p\) divides two consecutive terms. Their gcd is therefore at least \(2\), and writing their sum as \(gq\) with \(g,q\ge2\) makes the defining next value \(g+q\), which cannot equal the claimed \(1+gq\), yielding a contradiction at index \(249580077008\).
